_comment: 666 Streaming Node.js 22 custom-image egg. Build the repository Dockerfile on the Wings node or publish your own image. Author is a panel-admin template field.
name: 666 Streaming
author: admin@example.com
description: 666 Streaming: JavaScript ES Modules, Node.js 22, FFmpeg/FFprobe and approved standalone yt-dlp. Optional official discord.js v14 bot/audio; video in web player, no selfbot.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
if [[ -f package-lock.json && -f src/index.js ]]; then
  npm ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit
  npm run build
  npm prune --omit=dev --no-fund --no-audit
else
  echo "666 Streaming: empty volume will be seeded from the custom Node22 image at first start."
fi
echo "Runtime must provide Node22, FFmpeg, FFprobe and standalone yt-dlp. No Python/pip installation required."

variables.name: Workspace password
variables.description: Set a long private password. Empty generates DATA_DIR/initial-password; never use a Discord user token.

variables.name: Public root URL
variables.description: Public HTTP(S) root URL for watch links.

variables.name: Secure cookies
variables.description: Use true behind HTTPS. Use false for direct HTTP testing.

variables.name: Encoder
variables.description: CPU default. GPU encoders require actual host device/driver support.

variables.name: Concurrent streams
variables.description: Limit streams according to your CPU/RAM/disk.

variables.name: Official Discord bot token (optional)
variables.description: OFFICIAL application bot token only. Never a user-account token.

variables.name: Discord admin IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated admin user IDs, not tokens.

variables.name: Development guild IDs (optional)
variables.description: Comma-separated guild IDs for immediate slash command registration. Empty uses global registration.
